metadata.name: Gridiron
metadata.description:
[h1]Gridiron: American football for Isaac[/h1] Suit up! Football gear with its own mechanics: no reskins, no stat-only items.
[h2]What's inside[/h2] [list] [*][b]20 items[/b]: Football Helmet (tackles, stuns and a facemask), Shoulder Pads, Team Jersey, Football Cleats, Eye Black, Receiver Gloves, Mouthguard, Padded Pants, QB Wristband, Foam Finger, Super Bowl Ring, Gatorade Bucket, plus the Kicking Tee, Pigskin, Playbook, Coach's Whistle and End Zone actives [*][b]4 legendary Q4 items[/b]: Championship Ring, Hall of Fame Jacket, Golden Arm, Hail Mary [*][b]3 familiars[/b]: Cheerleader, Water Boy, Tackling Dummy [*][b]3 trinkets, a card and a pill[/b]: Referee Flag, Concussion Protocol, Turf Burn, Coin Toss, Timeout! [*][b]Wear 3+ pieces to get Suited Up[/b]: bonus damage, faster tackles, gold glow [*][b]Worn costumes[/b]: modern helmet with facemask, jersey over pads, pants and cleats, eye black, fitted per character [*][b]Football in the basement[/b]: game fields with goalposts, locker rooms, practice fields and torn turf [*][b]Every character in their own colours[/b] (or pick your team colours) [*][b]Boss themes[/b], a [b]Pro Shop[/b], six more trinkets, two more cards and a pill [*][b]Stadium sounds[/b]: crowd cheers and boos, helmet clacks, the air horn and a scoring fanfare [*][b]Pick your team colours[/b]: helmet, jersey and pants, 11 colours each (yes, pink too), from the settings menu [*][b]Three bosses and 10 football enemies[/b]: The Linebacker, The Mascot, The Franchise (a two-phase final boss), the Coach miniboss, plus Mascot, Referee, Lineman, Blitzer, Punter, Huddle, Gatorade Cooler, Chain Gang and Sacker [*][b]Three new characters[/b]: The Quarterback, The Kicker and The Coach, plus their tainted versions [*][b]All-Pro transformation[/b], [b]Team Captain[/b] champions, a [b]Halftime show[/b] event and [b]completion notes[/b] [*][b]5 challenges[/b]: Fourth and Long, Two-Minute Drill, Ground Game, Special Teams, Sudden Death [*][b]Settings[/b] in the Dead Sea Scrolls menu (press C), External Item Descriptions support, save & continue support [/list]
[h2]Synergies with base-game items[/h2] [list] [*]Mars dashes are tackles; Aries and Taurus make tackles go live faster; Leo, Thunder Thighs and friends hit harder [*]Magneto and Telekinesis help the Receiver Gloves; Infamy helps the Shoulder Pads [*]Brimstone, Technology, Mom's Knife and other non-tear weapons still throw footballs [*]Footballs take on your tear effects: fire, poison, holy light, ice, charm, Midas... [*]Explosive items make bigger field goals; magnets make better fumbles [*]Holy Water, lemons, Ball of Tar and Juicy Sack turn the Gatorade shower into creep [*]Pony speeds up first downs; Money = Power doubles the Super Bowl Ring; Marked boosts the Foam Finger [*]Tarot Cloth lands the Coin Toss on its edge; BFFS! upgrades the sideline crew [*][b]Juiced[/b]: Roid Rage, Growth Hormones and friends make tackles brutal, but the referees run drug tests [*]Sports medicine: Knockout Drops, Percs!, Adrenaline, Ball of Bandages, Mom's Bracelet, Champion Belt, Number One and more [/list] EID lists every synergy on the item it belongs to.
Every piece of content can be switched off from the settings menu, and other mods can hook in through the global [b]Gridiron[/b] API.
Debug console: [b]gridiron give[/b] drops all the gear as pedestals, [b]gridiron boss[/b] summons the Linebacker.
Requires Repentance+. REPENTOGON is not required. Source and bug reports: github.com/bulmaspanties/tboifbm
